novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a relational mechanism and measurement: logically linked beliefs allegedly occupy a “partially aligned representational subspace,” while failures reflect a measurable “coherence gap” that is “causally repairable” through propagation alignment. The closest work is Probing the Geometry of Truth (2025), which studies truth-direction consistency across logical transformations, together with RippleEdits (Cohen et al., 2023), ChainEdit (2025), and Content-free Logical Modification (2025), which respectively examine propagation to related facts, rule-guided chain updates, and interventions on internal logic representations; searches used variants of “LLM internal belief coherence geometry logical entailment subspace,” “truth direction logical transformations,” and “activation steering logical consistency belief propagation.” Moving from those works to pairwise subspace alignment as a predictor and causal repair target for native belief contradictions is a non-trivial integration and changed unit of analysis, but it is a natural extension of truth-geometry, logical-consistency steering, and knowledge-editing ripple research rather than a wholly new core paradigm.
